   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  MAY 12, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 5:59 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon, Vice Chair
Ang, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior
Management Analyst, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Jocelyn Hernandez, Communications
Specialist and Jonathan Gonzalez, Community Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes
for April 14, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Native Plant Presentation

Anna Valcarcel and Joy Tsuhako of Cerritos College provided a power-point presentation on the history
of native plants to the City of Norwalk and the benefits of having them. Chair Leon thanked the
professors for their presentation and asked if Cerritos College has a landscape design program an
individual can partner with. The Professors stated Cerritos College currently does not have a landscape
program but hope to offer several more workshops to educate and assist in interested individuals in
that manner. The professors suggested using the website Calscape.org for a list of native plants and
nurseries where one can obtain them. During the oral communications portion of this presentation,
Norwalk resident, Brian Tindall, thanked the Cerritos College professors for the presentation and
thanked the Commission for learning more about this topic and looks forward to how the Commission
will proceed on spreading this information to the community.

Home & Business Beautification Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda provided contest winner information to the Commission. She explained that the winner
of the Home Improvement category was disqualified due to not having obtained permits for the exterior
work of the home. Prizes were delivered with one prize delivery left and is scheduled to take place at
the end of the week.

Commissioner Appreciation Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners with three food quotes as requested. Commissioners all
agreed to ordering Don’s Terriyaki Grill. Mrs. Ocegueda showed the Commission the messenger bag
that will be given to Commissioners as the party favor. Mrs. Ocegueda asked for clarification on how
they wished to ask guests to take the merchandise survey. Vice Chair Ang suggested to have printed
copies of the survey and use them as the “meal ticket”. Commissioners all agreed on this format. Vice
Chair Ang also suggested putting the survey QR code in the Norwalk Now. Miss Santa Ana confirmed
it will be in the Norwalk Now, June edition. All Commissioners confirmed their attendance at the event.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
May 12, 2025

Business Spotlight

Miss Hernandez showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the May Best Lunch Special Spots edition
video to Commissioners.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Miss Hernandez provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics. Vice
Chair Ang asked if the city’s new website was being promoted on water bills and parking citations. Miss
Santa Ana stated she would check with departments to see if it can be promoted on any city related
paperwork.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang presented an outline on a new social media series campaign based on an Instagram
account called “LA in a minute” he follows he would like the Commission and City staff to consider.
Commissioners discussed details and Chair Leon asked staff to discuss details with Communications
Director, Levy Sun, and add it to the monthly meeting agenda to further discuss.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

Norwalk resident, Jack Cornejo, stated when he last attended a Community Promotion Commission
meeting, there was discussion about city branded merchandise and wanted to share a picture he took
of the branded merchandise he saw at the La Habra Senior Center to give the Commission an idea of
what was being offered elsewhere. Commissioners reviewed the picture provided by Mr. Cornejo and
discussed logo ideas and collaborations with high school art classes including Cerritos College students
for a limited-edition series. Commissioners asked Mrs. Ocegueda to discuss mock-up logo ideas with
the marketing team with some of their recommendations to see what can be produced.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:41 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
